**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeScrollEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeScrollEvent.java)

The event of `beforeScroll`, which can refuse a scroll of a node.

## Description

It fires for a scroll that the wheel, a scrollbar or a call such as `scrollTo(...)` asks for.

## Learn more

- [Layout](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/layout/#react-to-scrolling)
